properties.title: Triple shooting · Yarwood Court
properties.address: 10300 block of Yarwood Court, St. Louis County, MO
properties.source: First Alert 4 · North County Police Cooperative reporting
properties.description: The North County Police Cooperative reported that three people were shot in the 10300 block of Yarwood Court around 11 a.m. on November 24. Two injuries were described as non-life-threatening; the third person's condition was not reported. Police later reported that four suspects faced assault, weapons or related charges after officers recovered guns equipped with machine-gun conversion devices. Preliminary accusations; not findings of guilt.
